grading.scale: Count-based, not percent: the letter depends on how many items are completed or passed (see components); for online and in-class tasks the required count is the listed number or the scale A=90%, B=80%, C=70%, D=60%, whichever is lower.
grading.extraCredit: The text says additional or last-minute online and in-class tasks work as a kind of extra credit.

ARTI 2130.finalExam: No final exam is named; the final project is due 12/1 and presented Tuesday, Dec 8, 12-3pm (dates tentative).

ARTI 2130.attendance: No attendance is taken and there are no excused absences; tasks have built-in wiggle room, but arriving late or leaving early may cost part or all of an in-class task.
ARTI 2130.lateWork: For major assignments other than quizzes, a 3-day extension is approved automatically if requested with the revise-and-resubmit form on eLC by the due date.
ARTI 2130.makeups: Each student starts with 2 growth tokens to revise or retake a quiz, or revise an essay or self-assessment; they cannot be used on final projects, in-class activities or online writing.
